def choose_move(observation):
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    allies = observation.get('allies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', [])
    position = observation.get('position', (0, 0))
    grid_width = observation.get('grid_width', 10)
    grid_height = observation.get('grid_height', 10)

    x, y = position

    if resources:
        resource = min(resources, key=lambda p: abs(p[0] - x) + abs(p[1] - y))
        tx, ty = resource
    elif enemies:
        enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda p: abs(p[0] - x) + abs(p[1] - y))
        tx, ty = enemy
    elif territory:
        sx = sum(pos[0] for pos in territory) / len(territory)
        sy = sum(pos[1] for pos in territory) / len(territory)
        tx, ty = sx, sy
    else:
        tx, ty = grid_width / 2, grid_height / 2

    delta_x = tx - x
    delta_y = ty - y

    dx = 1 if delta_x > 0 else -1 if delta_x < 0 else 0
    dy = 1 if delta_y > 0 else -1 if delta_y < 0 else 0

    return [dx, dy]
